name: core-cookie-map-runtime-depth

source.content: Cookie base = new Cookie('sid', 'alpha', '/secure', 3600, true); Cookie sameSite = new Cookie('sid', 'alpha', '/secure', 3600, true, 'Lax'); Cookie full = new Cookie('sid', 'alpha', '/secure', 3600, true, 'Strict', true); System.assertEquals('/secure', base.getPath()); System.assertEquals(3600, base.getMaxAge()); System.assertEquals('Lax', sameSite.getSameSite()); System.assertEquals(null, full.getDomain()); System.assertEquals('Strict', full.getSameSite()); System.assertEquals(true, full.isHttpOnly()); System.assertEquals(true, full.isSecure()); System.assertEquals('alpha', full.getValue()); System.assert(full.toString().length() > 0); Map<String,Object> first = new Map<String,Object>{'key' => 'one'}; Map<String,Object> copied = new Map<String,Object>(first); System.assert(copied.equals(first)); System.assertEquals(copied.hashCode(), first.hashCode()); copied.put('key', 'two'); System.assertEquals('one', (String)first.get('key')); System.assertEquals('two', (String)copied.get('key'));
